headline.purpose: Book title on the continue-reading card.

title.purpose: Section headings and sheet titles; semantic headers.

caption.purpose: Tabular progress state under tiles and rows.

band-code.purpose: Format code printed on a cover band; never scales with system font size.

motion.name: ink-sparkle
motion.purpose: Material pressed feedback on every tappable surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Paper pill with ink label; the one main action on a surface (Resume, Retry, Import).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ECEAE4; color: #111315; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F4F1EA; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E0742E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #26292D; color: #A8A59E; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Paper label on a 1px outline pill; secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: #ECEAE4; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #6B7076; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(236,234,228,0.08); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E0742E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Card-filled, borderless at rest; 2px press orange border on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1C1F22; color: #ECEAE4; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; caret-color: #E0742E; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A8A59E; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #E0742E; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Nav ink bar; selected destination wears a press orange pill with an ink icon.
components.html: LibrarySettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; background: #16191B; height: 72px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-item { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #A8A59E; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-ind { display: flex; justify-content: center; width: 64px; padding: 4px 0; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { color: #ECEAE4; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active .ds-nav-ind { background: #E0742E; color: #111315; } .ds-nav-item:hover .ds-nav-ind { background: rgba(236,234,228,0.08); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active:hover .ds-nav-ind { background: #E0742E; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E0742E; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Card pill with rule border; selected fills press orange.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #1C1F22; color: #ECEAE4; border: 1px solid #33383D; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #26292D; } .ds-chip-on { background: #E0742E; color: #111315; font-weight: 700; border-color: #E0742E; }

components.name: Book Cover
components.description: 2:3 paperback, bands 3:4:3 in the format colour, cream title label, format code in ink.
components.css: .ds-cover { width: 120px; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; color: #111315; } .ds-band { flex: 3; background: #5B8FD6; } .ds-label { flex: 4; background: #F4F1EA; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-band-code { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; padding-bottom: 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.2px; }

components.name: Continue Reading Card
components.description: Card surface, 16px corners, 14px inset; band progress bar in the book's colour, tabular meta row, Resume pill.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1C1F22; border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; color: #ECEAE4; max-width: 280px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #26292D; overflow: hidden; } .ds-fill { width: 18%; height: 100%; background: #5B8FD6; } .ds-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 6px 0 12px; color: #A8A59E; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-btn { background: #ECEAE4; color: #111315; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; font: 700 15px Figtree, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E0742E; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The app chrome is a dark shelf of mid-century paperbacks. A near-black ink ground carries one lifted card surface, warm paper-white type, and a set of flat print colours, one per document format, applied as horizontal series bands on every cover. A reader can scan the shelf by colour before reading a single title, and the band colour follows the book from its cover to its progress bar.

The system is dark-only and flat. Depth comes from tonal steps of ink and card, never from shadow, gloss, texture or gold. Built on Material 3 components (navigation bar and rail, filled and outlined buttons, sheets, dialogs, snackbars), it presents one custom, platform-neutral look on Android and iOS. The brand shows up in colour roles, in Figtree set in a tight heavy weight range, in pill-shaped controls, and in the bands. Visitor mode is Operate: dense enough for daily use, legible at night, with no ornament competing with the books.

Contrast is never traded for mood. Paper on ink measures 15.5:1. Muted paper measures 7.6:1 on ink and 6.7:1 on card. Ink on every band measures at least 5.6:1.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only chrome on near-black ink, with one lifted card tone.
Six flat format bands, each always paired with its format code in dark ink.
One brand accent, press orange, kept to navigation, focus, selection and the EPUB band.
Figtree only, bundled with the app, in weights 400 to 800, with tabular figures for numbers.
Pill controls, a 16px gutter, flat surfaces, no shadows.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Press orange marks navigation, focus, selection and EPUB, and nothing else. It is never a second luxury accent or decoration, and no gold appears anywhere.

rules.name: The Band Pairs With Its Code Rule
rules.body: A band colour never stands alone as meaning. Its format code in ink sits on the cover band, and the screen-reader label names the format.

rules.name: The Readable Muted Rule
rules.body: Secondary text uses paper-muted, never paper at reduced opacity, so it holds 4.5:1 or better on both ink and card.

rules.name: The Cover Does Not Scale Rule
rules.body: Text printed on a cover (band code, title and author on the cream label) uses TextScaler.noScaling, because cover art keeps its proportions. Every caption outside the cover follows the system font size, and the grid tile height is computed from the scaled text so nothing clips at large sizes.

rules.name: The Section Heading Rule
rules.body: Sections are introduced by a Title-weight heading in sentence case. Small tracked uppercase labels above headings (kickers or eyebrows) are not part of this system.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, gradients or textures. If a layer needs to separate, move it one tonal step up.

dos: Do resolve a document's colour through context.bands.forFormat(format), and print its format code on the band in ink.
Do use paper-muted for secondary text and outline for any boundary that must read at 3:1 or better.
Do keep every surface at elevation 0 with a transparent surface tint, and separate layers by tonal step.
Do set numbers (counts, percentages, recency) in tabular figures.
Do keep cover text unscaled and size every caption and grid tile from the user's text scale.

Do keep the reading page's own themes separate from the chrome. The light, sepia and dark page palettes in reader_screen.dart (_ReaderPalette) are not yet redesigned and are not part of this world; they remain pending.
donts: Don't use press orange as decoration or as a second accent. It belongs to navigation, focus, selection and EPUB only.
Don't introduce gold, texture, gradients, gloss or shadows.
Don't use kickers or eyebrows (small tracked uppercase labels above a heading). Use a sentence-case section heading.
Don't show a band colour without its format code, and don't recolour a band for emphasis.
Don't lower contrast for mood. Never set text below 4.5:1 or use translucent paper for secondary text.
Don't fetch fonts at runtime or fall back to a system display face. Figtree is bundled.
